newsitem.title: UK: British police arrest duo over stolen Picasso.
newsitem.headline: British police arrest duo over stolen Picasso.

text.p: British police charged two men on Friday with conspiracy to handle a stolen work of art following the theft of a $1-million Picasso painting.
The hunt for the thief continues.

"Tete de Femme" was stolen from the Lefevre Gallery in London's Mayfair district last week by a man armed with a shotgun. He ran out of the gallery and hijacked a passing taxi, which he abandoned in south London.
The 1939 impressionist portrait was recovered on Thursday.
Police said the picture did not appear to be damaged but had been removed from its frame.
Peter Scott, 66, and Ronald Spring, 69, both of north London, are due to appear in court on Saturday, police said.
